title: Monitor Alert
description: EXECUTE/DISCOVER-stage artifact (advisory). Output of monitor. Records per-run alerts derived deterministically from run_record status and budget fields (stalled, over_budget, failed, cost_spike). Advisory only — no BLOCK verdict. The monitor has little to watch until real GPU runs exist.

alerts.description: Per-run alerts. Empty array means all runs are healthy.

run_ref.description: Reference to the run_record or run_manifest that triggered this alert.

severity.description: Advisory severity. Never triggers a BLOCK gate.

evidence_ref.description: Non-empty list of evidence pointers — anti-slop guard.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of the alert. Optional.
